prompt:

Match Image 1 exactly for color, shapes and simplified low-noise cel rendering. Clean dark line, large flat colors, one hard shadow per material, no painterly texture. Show separate isolated orthographic detail drawings with generous spacing; no character full body and no scenery. NO text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, logos or watermarks.
AUTHORITATIVE DETAILS TO DRAW: large front and rear mantle construction, hair clip on head front/back, shoulder clasp close-up, sword front and thin side view with scabbard, record pouch closed and open.
EXACT OBJECT RULES: One straight silver-blue one-handed sword, length 85 cm, narrow double-edge blade, simple silver FOUR-point diamond-star guard with ONE blue diamond center, navy grip, plain silver pommel; one plain navy scabbard at LEFT hip, right hand wielding. Pouch is a plain black rectangle with ONE silver diamond clasp; crescent hair clip and crescent shoulder clasp have no dangling pieces.
HARD LOCKS: 蓝发紫蓝眼; 本人右侧月牙发夹1枚; 本人左肩月牙扣1枚; 腰横扣2枚; 记录包在左腰; 右手剑左手法术; 双腿服装对称.
Every object must be shown once unless front/back or open/closed views are explicitly requested. Keep counts exact. No additional jewelry, charms, stars, chains, flowers, weapons, readable writing or decorative filler.
